description: For the actual certified checker presenting an arithmetic theory \(T\supseteq Q\), there is a total computable function \(f(p,n)\) such that every accepted proof certificate \(p\) of code \(n\) is transformed into an accepted certificate \(f(p,n)\) of \(\operatorname{Prov}_T(\overline n)\). The function also terminates on invalid inputs; no primitive-recursive bound is asserted.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.computable_introspection_compiler (E : ℕ → ℕ → Bool) (hE : Primrec₂ E)
  (hQ :
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.Q ⊆
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.theory Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature
        E) :
  ∃ f,
    Computable f ∧
      ∀ (p n : ℕ),
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature E p n =
            true →
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.certificateCheck
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.arithmeticSignature E (f (p, n))
              (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.provabilityCode
                (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.FormalizedProvability.certificateRepresentation E hE) n) =
            true
